name: Adib Hassan
about:
Adib Hassan has completed his undergraduate degree from the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) at Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET), Bangladesh. He is an emerging researcher with a strong interest in photonics, plasmonics, and biomedical sensing technologies, particularly in the development and optimization of advanced Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) biosensors for medical diagnostics.

His research focuses on high-sensitivity SPR-based biosensing systems for the detection of infectious diseases. His work involves the design and optimization of highly sensitive prism-based and photonic crystal fiber (PCF)-based SPR sensors using numerical and multiphysics simulation techniques, including Transfer Matrix Method (TMM), Finite Element Method (FEM), MATLAB, and COMSOL Multiphysics. His recent research explores the integration of novel two-dimensional nanomaterials, bimetallic structures, graphene oxide, indium nitride, and other advanced materials to enhance sensor sensitivity, specificity, and detection accuracy.

Alongside his research activities, he is actively involved in academic leadership and professional organizations. He currently serves as Chair of IEEE RUET Student Branch, Vice Chair of the IEEE Computer Society Bangladesh Chapter Secretariat Executive Committee, and Vice Chair of RUET CORE. He also holds the position of Director of Hult Prize RUET and serves as Secretary of the Notre Dame College Association of RUET. Through these roles, he contributes to fostering innovation, leadership development, technical engagement, and student-driven initiatives within academic and professional communities.

His broader academic interests include nanophotonics, optical sensing systems, computational electromagnetics, and interdisciplinary biomedical engineering applications. He is particularly motivated by research that bridges fundamental science with practical healthcare solutions, aiming to contribute to the development of affordable and efficient diagnostic technologies.

Adib Hassan is committed to pursuing advanced research in optical biosensing and related interdisciplinary fields, with the long-term goal of contributing to impactful innovations in biomedical diagnostics and applied photonics.
